purpose: Teach: カーソル/落合/錬金術/色気/ポルシェ/初恋/川柳/バッシング

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、PC操作でカーソルが行方不明だってお困りだったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the customer was having trouble—their cursor disappeared on them.
lines.style: Dry observation. Quick, almost amused. Matter-of-fact delivery, like noting something slightly absurd. No sympathy yet, just recognition.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、落合さんという作家ファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer mentioned they're a fan of the author Ochiai.
lines.style: Soft, thoughtful. Slight pause before the name, like she's remembering. Warm tone, noticing something that matters to someone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、錬金術の歴史小説を読まれてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They were reading Ochiai's historical novel about alchemy.
lines.style: Quiet interest. Gentle, curious phrasing. The voice of someone piecing together who this person is. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、色気のあるバラの香水着けてらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They were wearing an alluring rose perfume.
lines.style: Soft observation, almost intimate in noticing. Not judgmental—appreciative of the detail. Tender attention to small things.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ポルシェに乗ってお越しになったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They drove here in a Porsche.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact note. No awe, no judgment. Just another piece of the picture. Quiet delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、初恋のお話をされたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They shared a story about their first love.
lines.style: Softer opening. Gentle reverence for the moment they shared something tender. Careful, warm phrasing. Like holding something fragile.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、川柳を作るのが趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Writing senryu poetry—short poems—is their hobby.
lines.style: Thoughtful, admiring. Warm recognition of something that reveals character. Slow, appreciative delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、芸能人のバッシング報道について議論されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They were discussing the celebrity scandal coverage.
lines.style: Quiet, measured observation. Close, intimate delivery—speaking as if to someone she trusts. Thoughtful distance.
